proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1634 includes uccā/uccaiḥ ‘above’, Old Marwari uco, Hindi ū̃c/ū̃cā and Gujarati ū̃cũ; adverbial use of the high adjective fits the elicitation. Turner explicitly doubts deriving nasal forms directly from udañc, so nasalization and local endings are qualified rather than assigned a separate unsupported parent.
